3A12 Revision 89 Textron Aviation 172 172I 172A 172K 172B 172L 172C 172M 172D 172N 172E 172P 172F (USAF T-41A) 172Q 172G 172R 172H (USAF T-41A) 172S September 15, 2026
WARNING: Use of alcohol-based fuels can cause serious performance degradation and fuel system component damage and is therefore prohibited on Cessna airplanes.

This data sheet which is part of Type Certificate No. 3A12 prescribes conditions and limitations under which the product for which the type certificate was issued meets the airworthiness requirements of the Federal Aviation Regulations.
